rights.title: Your rights under the DPDP Act 2023

access.title: Right to access (Sec 11)
access.body: Ask for a summary of your data and who it was shared with.

erasure.title: Right to erasure (Sec 12)
erasure.body: Ask us to delete your data once it is no longer needed.

grievance.body: Our Data Protection Officer will resolve complaints; you can escalate to the Data Protection Board of India.

erase.title: Delete my data
erase.body: This permanently deletes your field boundary, applications, satellite results and contact details from TVS Credit systems. A record that the deletion happened is kept, as RBI and PMLA rules require.
